ext.description: View large log files smoothly in VS Code: loading shows real progress, search/filter/paging respond instantly, and line/time jumps stream straight to the target. Regex and multi-keyword search, level/thread/time filters, repeated-line folding, bookmarks, comments, timeline, and reusable investigation templates.
config.title: Open Log Viewer
config.search.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before the search runs automatically as you type in the search box.
config.collapse.minRepeatCount.descripti: Minimum number of consecutive repetitions before repeated log lines get folded.
config.timeline.samplePoints.description: Number of sample points in the timeline view. Higher values are more precise but take longer to compute.
config.view.foldLongLines.description: Fold extra-long log lines (e.g. JSON payloads thousands of characters long): only the first few rows are shown, click a line to expand it in full, so the mouse wheel can sweep through a page in a few notches. The toolbar checkbox can toggle this per session. Takes effect after reopening or refreshing the log file.
config.view.foldMaxRows.description: Number of visual rows to keep when folding a long line (1-50). Takes effect after reopening or refreshing the log file.
config.theme.description: Visual theme of the log viewer. You can also switch it temporarily from the Theme option in the viewer's settings panel.
config.theme.enumDescription.0: Default theme (follows the current VS Code theme)
config.level.aliases.description: Aliases for log levels (keys limited to ERROR/WARN/INFO/DEBUG). Standard level words (ERROR/FATAL/SEVERE/WARN/WARNING/INFO/INFORMATION/DEBUG/TRACE/VERBOSE) are always recognized; this table only defines extra aliases, and editing the value replaces the defaults entirely — for example, if "I" means something else in your logs, remove it from the INFO array. Single-character aliases are only recognized right after a timestamp or inside square brackets, never as standalone words, so "I/O" or the letter "I" in message text is not mistaken for a level. Changes take effect after reopening or refreshing the log file.

config.file.encoding.description: Default encoding for log files. The default "auto" detects automatically: BOM first, then a strict UTF-8 probe, falling back to GBK. Pin GBK / UTF-16 here if you know the file format to avoid misdetection; the "Encoding" dropdown in the viewer toolbar also switches temporarily (per panel session). Changes take effect after reopening or refreshing the log file.
config.file.encoding.enumDescription.0: Auto detect (BOM first, then UTF-8, fallback GBK)
config.file.encoding.enumDescription.3: UTF-16 LE (usually with BOM, e.g. PowerShell redirection)
config.load.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum log file size (MB) to open. Logs are loaded fully into memory; files over this limit are rejected with a clear message instead of hanging. Defaults to 1024 (1GB); set 0 for no limit. Larger limits mean higher memory usage.
